Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer made an error in effectively identifying and retrieving the correct official script document for "Heaven Sent" from the BBC Writers Room website. Despite multiple iterations, it repeatedly navigated to or reopened the same link without confirming whether the content needed (the specific first scene heading) was indeed available. This created a loop of redundant actions without progress toward the task goal. 

The issue lies in failing to adapt to the repeated inability to extract the first scene heading and persisting with the same ineffective strategy. Instead of verifying the correctness of the PDF document by locating the required information, the WebSurfer showed behavior consistent with Example 2 ("Repeated failures in retrieval of specific content") and Example 4 ("Stalled Interaction Feedback").
